name: Birsa Harit Gram Yojana
benefit: 1. Plantation of fruit-bearing and fodder trees on common land and private land. 1. Sustainable livelihood generation for marginalized families. 1. Employment guarantee of 100 days under MGNREGA. 1. Usufruct rights over the plantation for beneficiaries.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Primitive Tribes, or be a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should be a woman-headed household, a person with disabilities, or a beneficiary of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY). 1. The applicant should be a small or marginal farmer. 1. The applicant should possess a MGNREGA job card. 1. The applicant's livelihood should primarily depend on agriculture.
